title: New Pretext site /api/media/*.mp4 returns 413 (videos do not play): media route must redirect to a presigned S3 URL like the old fork
description: On the new Threat Intelligence site (app dzefa11i80jyq) every /api/media/**.mp4 returns HTTP 413 with an empty body (14 distinct URLs, Range requests too). The old live site answers 307 to a presigned S3 URL. Fix: media route redirects (307) to a short-lived presigned GET URL so S3 serves bytes and Range; IAM grant if missing; unit tests with a fake presigner in test:ci:ts; docs. Then roll out to the new TI app. See comment on PPY-4f2519 for evidence.

comments.author: home
comments.text: [2026-10-07 18:30 EDT] Root cause: app/api/media/[...path]/route.ts proxied the S3 body (commit 4c9a3ce, done so next/image would work); the SSR compute response size cap turns the 26 MB videos into HTTP 413. The fork redirected (307). IAM/storage rules were already fine (guest read on media/*; signing worked for images). Fix (layer: Papyrus route): images stay proxied (optimizer does not follow redirects), all other media get a 307 to a 1h presigned URL so S3 serves bytes and Range. lib/media-route-response.ts, test:media-route in test:ci:ts (fake signer), docs/site-hosting.md. Papyrus PR #164 merged as d9ac9f6, released 1.0.0-next.30 (npm registry lagged ~8 min after the Release run). No stack/template change needed. TI PR #14 (pure pin bump to next.30, lockfile, infra/site.json) merged; new app build job 9 SUCCEED; old app auto-build false, latest job still 71. Checks on 3 videos: Range 0-1023 and full request answer 307 to the media bucket host; following with GET gives 206 video/mp4 (1024 bytes). Note: HEAD on the presigned URL returns 403 because the signature is for GET; browsers use GET. Headless Chrome: video.play() resolved, readyState 4, duration 199 s. / 307 to /2026/july/04 (200), /newsroom 200, old site 200.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Fixed and verified on the new site.

right_now_summary: Media routes now redirect videos to presigned S3 URLs, and playback works on the new site.
